title: Preserve authored system layouts and bar display scales
scope: Preserve the two evidenced GPIF layout slices: score/track system arrays and master/bar scale XProperties.
acceptance: Retain score ScoreSystemsDefaultLayout/ScoreSystemsLayout and track SystemsDefautLayout/SystemsLayout, including the source spelling, differing explicit arrays and default values.
Keep score and track settings independently editable; explicit track layouts take precedence for that track, otherwise use score layout. Do not flatten or overwrite the retained authored arrays.
Preserve master scale XProperty 1124073984 and bar scale 1124139520, including the resized.gp values 0.5, 2 and 0.5 and a caller edit.

Use systems-layout/multi-track-different.gp and resized.gp for exact wire, public import/reparse and Go-export-to-AlphaTab assertions. Validate counts, finite positive scales and malformed arrays without narrowing silently.
exclusions: Legacy LineBreakBreak/Protect projection and displayWidth are excluded; their existing reports remain.
Pinned AlphaTab re-export omits scales, so its re-export is not the preservation oracle for this slice.

reproduction.instructions: Retain score ScoreSystemsDefaultLayout/ScoreSystemsLayout and track SystemsDefautLayout/SystemsLayout, including the source spelling, differing explicit arrays and default values. See the linked investigation decision and review receipt for the confirmed baseline.

evidence.detail: implementation-ready: Both system arrays and scale XProperties have explicit pinned GPIF parser assignments and non-default fixtures. Two closely related layout slices can share one bounded public contract.
Original multi-track-different, resized and GP6 compressed source plus edited exact raw consumer counts/scales.

resolution: Implemented independent score and track system counts, exact master/bar scales and checked public/source values. Original GP7 and GP6 raw consumer assertions pass, including bounded unreachable GP6 terminal remainder. Missing track layout inherits score counts with a scoped normalization and no input mutation. Legacy line breaks/displayWidth remain excluded. Awaiting fresh independent review and integrated gates/probe. Fresh review caught an explicit empty track scope disappearing across exports. The fix emits an empty array with an exact normalization report and retains scope across both raw consumer exports.
